component.name: Calendar
component.summary: Keep track of events and reminders

description.p: Calendar is the Bingux desktop's calendar. It keeps events in ordinary calendar files, one folder for each calendar, so it needs no account and works the first time it opens.

ul.li: Day, week, month, year and agenda views
Quick add in plain words, such as "Lunch with Sam tomorrow 1pm"
Repeating events, changed for one occurrence, the following ones or all of them
Reminders that show when an event is due, with the window closed
Import of .ics files by opening them or dropping them on the window
